plainTranslation: Composite Mercury in the 8 House: 30/ ​© The Dark Pixie Astrology With Composite Mercury in the 8th house, you can open up about serious subjects and issues with one another, and talk about the things you hold deep inside of yourselves. You can dig into one another to gain more understanding of each other than you may have with anyone else. Communications between you can be intense, rarely light, and you do have to watch for having some epic fights. When you don’t see eye-to-eye, you each may try to dominate and control the conversation, but you need to be more open.
policy: Composite chart entries describe the relationship as a third entity. Read alongside synastry; do not use as a verdict on whether a relationship should continue.
